latest_result: New B3R allocation pilot completed (200 DEV questions; 1,000 training questions; 3 seeds): at 2 pair labels/question, set-aware FS@2 0.292 vs random 0.317, paired Δ −0.025 [−0.058,+0.010]; at 5 pairs 0.298 vs 0.325, Δ −0.027 [−0.057,−0.000]. No positive feedback-allocation signal. C5 job failed CUDA OOM (A0 passed; 0 training fits); C6 two-GPU pipeline reached data stage then failed in both slate workers, with its allocation still running at the last check.

gpu_verified.note: Read-only Slurm check of both authorized identities at ~10:04 IST; C5 one-GPU job FAILED with CUDA OOM on GTX 1080 Ti. C6's 2-GPU allocation was still running although its pipeline had exited at the slate stage. Counts are point-in-time, not utilization telemetry.
gpu_verified.observed_gpu_model: 2× NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 Ti (P1 C6 only)

blockers: C5 G5 is unmeasured: A0 passed but all six full-encoder fits remain incomplete after CUDA out-of-memory on one GTX 1080 Ti; Terra's protocol audit also flags a sequence-length fallback and early holdout evaluations.

C6 has no metric: data preparation succeeded, but both GPU slate workers crashed because tokenization returned a string field passed to .to(device); two GPUs remained allocated as of ~10:04 IST despite pipeline exit.

B3R is complete but negative on 200 DEV questions. Random versus set-aware teacher-token budgets are approximately equal at 2 labels/question (508,381 vs 508,091) but not at 5 labels (971,006 vs 1,252,556).
B3R's 3-seed CI resamples 200 DEV questions after averaging seed outcomes; it does not quantify across-seed uncertainty. Only a frozen MiniLM query adapter was trained.
The original 400-question pilot holdout has been exposed; B3R did not re-materialize it. No fresh independent open-corpus evidence or cross-dataset confirmation exists.
P1 Wave2 selection-scale NFCorpus pilot completed only one full seed, with no completed FiQA domain and no independently validated teacher-vs-gold claim; small/budgeted DEV effects are exploratory.
Novelty remains tightly constrained by SCARLet, PRD, DISCo and SetR. Boundary-aware acquisition has not passed its empirical gate.
The public status page is a dated snapshot with advisory noindex, not a live connection to Slurm or the Mac.

audit.methodology: P1 C5 A0=0.678792 passed but zero full-encoder fits; code audit FAIL means even a recovered run must be checked against frozen protocol. P5 B3R trained only a 384→64→384 residual query adapter with 3 seeds, not a full bi-encoder. Reported 95% intervals bootstrap 200 DEV questions after averaging seeds, not training-seed uncertainty; multiple DEV policy comparisons are unadjusted.
audit.split_integrity: P5 B3R selected 1,000 training examples from a 6,742-query training pool; 200 DEV questions and 400 HOLDOUT IDs. 400-question pilot holdout was previously exposed; B3R did not materialize its question/passage rows. No independent confirmatory P5 test. P1 C5 A0 holdout gate required but per-fit holdout writes violate final-only evaluation discipline.
audit.cost: B3R scored 9,857 physical shared-cache teacher endpoints; per-arm counterfactual uncached endpoints and teacher-token counts recorded separately. 2 pair labels/question: random 508,381 vs set-aware 508,091 tokens. 5 labels: random 971,006 vs set-aware 1,252,556 tokens (+29% set-aware). Therefore equal pair-label budgets are not strictly equal teacher-token budgets. Selection-stage teacher calls zero for both.
audit.novelty: New B3R DEV comparison is negative for set-aware selection, not a new contribution. P1 teacher selection has prior art in GPL/PairDistill/PRD; P5 set utility and pairwise supervision overlap SCARLet, PRD, DISCo, SetR. Distinguish the hypothesis of boundary-aware training-time allocation from measured results.
